information.description:
Ex-nomad, ex-merc or ex-corp, now driving an armored cab through whatever is between you and your stop. The meter runs during firefights.

Combat Cab: The armored taxi outfit that takes a fare anywhere in Night City, the Combat Zone included: "leave the combat to us."

Stat block by Neon Hub. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
